name: Karlinger
beschreibung: The Gasthof Karlinger is located in the Austrian federal state of Tirol. The dining room is traditionally furnished, with wood panelling and rustic benches. Guests are offered a selection of traditional Tiroler dishes made with regional ingredients. In addition to a breakfast buffet, dinner is also served. The drinks selection includes beers and Schnäpse from local production. In the warmer months, guests can use the outdoor dining area. The establishment is close to several hiking trails and is correspondingly busy. The service is attentive and uncomplicated.
